# gramlot-py-server 0.2.11

The five adapters share one base, `gramlot_py_server.base.Adapter`, built on the server API of Gramlot 0.3.6. Each adapter builds its routes and translates its framework request and response. The HTTP rules are written once, in the base.

A page path accepts GET only. HEAD and every other method answer 405 with `Allow: GET` in all five adapters. Django and Flask opened a page on HEAD before. Every 405 carries `Allow`.

Every response carries `Cache-Control: no-store`, except the runtime, which carries `no-cache`. The Uvicorn adapter sent `no-store` on the runtime before.

The owner cookie `gramlot_owner` is built in one place, with `Path`, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax` and no lifetime. The value sent by the browser is reused.

Every adapter calls `close_all` on shutdown. Uvicorn does it on the ASGI lifespan shutdown, FastAPI on its shutdown event and Kajenn in `on_shutdown`. Django and Flask have no shutdown signal: they call it when the interpreter exits.

The Kajenn adapter passes the avatar of each call as `identity` to `GramlotServer.call`, and `evaluate_auth(rule, *, owner, identity)` reads its tags. The server keeps no copy of the tags of an owner, so a login or a logout takes effect at the next call. The `kajenn` extra now declares `genro-routes>=0.30.1` and `genro-toolbox>=0.17.0`, which the adapter imports.

The core server of an adapter is `gramlot_server` in all five adapters. It was `server` in Django, Flask, FastAPI and Uvicorn.

The gallery staging accepts a JavaScript page module without `Logic`. The companion `<key>_aux.js` re-exports every name of the module with `export *`. It re-exported `Logic` by name before, which is a link error for a module that does not export it.

The guides link the split Gramlot guides on server calls and remote content, and the public server protocol. The reference describes `collections=`, the shared base, the options of the gallery command and the optional `Logic`. Projects created by `gramlot new` require `gramlot-py-server>=0.2.11`.

Requires Gramlot 0.3.6 or later. Update the active environment and restart the server.

Verified with 126 tests across the five adapters and the gallery staging, including a test that imports the staged companions with Node, with and without `Logic`.
